workload.note: 730 rushing yards, 144 receiving yards, 12 total/rushing TDs -- breakout season, career-best TD total. Was set up to be Seattle's clear No. 1 RB for 2026 once Kenneth Walker III's contract expired, before the playoff ACL tear (per Yahoo Sports/Randy Gurzi, Jun 28, 2026).
8 rushing TDs, 340 receiving yards on 42 catches.

contract.note: Playing on an expiring/final-year deal in 2026 per Yahoo Sports (Jun 29, 2026); no extension agreed as of that report. A strong healthy return would be needed to earn a second contract -- the ACL tear working against his leverage.

scheme.note: No 2026 Seahawks OC change specifically identified in sources checked this session.

competition.name: Kenneth Walker III
competition.status: Contract expired / no longer with team
competition.note: Per Yahoo Sports (Jun 29, 2026), Walker's contract expired, which was expected to clear the path for Charbonnet as Seattle's No. 1 back -- before the ACL injury intervened.

competition.name: Jadarian Price
competition.status: Rookie, first-round pick 2026, emerging as co-lead back
competition.note: Drafted in the first round (pick 32 per Field Gulls mock-draft context) to replace Kenneth Walker. Per roundtable.io (Aug 5, 2026, citing ESPN's Brady Henderson): 'Early indications suggest that Holani and Price will be the top two options, with Wilson mixing in as a powerful complement' -- i.e., Price is currently ahead of Charbonnet on the depth chart while Charbonnet remains on PUP.

competition.name: George Holani
competition.status: Incumbent RB, currently RB1/RB2 with Price
competition.note: Per roundtable.io (Aug 5, 2026), Holani is 'excelling as both runner and pass-catcher' and rising in the coaching staff's estimation while Charbonnet is out.

competition.name: Emanuel Wilson
competition.note: Per roundtable.io (Aug 5, 2026), signed as a powerful complement in a committee approach; has impressed as a pass-catcher in camp.

notes: Jul 22, 2026 official PUP-list depth chart (seahawks.com) listed order as: Charbonnet (out/PUP), Emanuel Wilson, Jadarian Price, George Holani, Jacardia Wright.
